Services

Every field of dentistry in one place

Therapy, surgery, prosthetics, orthodontics, implantology, periodontology, children's and aesthetic dentistry.

Therapeutic Dentistry

Cavity treatment and fillings — precise, gentle and natural-looking.

Dental Implants

A stable, natural-looking replacement for a missing tooth — built on a plan and diagnostics.

Crowns & Prosthetics

Safety & quality

What trust is built on

Sterility, accurate diagnostics and our own laboratory are the foundation of every treatment at NIO DENT.

Disinfection & Sterilisation

The highest level of disinfection and sterilisation, using modern equipment.

For you, that means safe, reliable treatment at every visit.

X-ray Diagnostics

Images are taken in the clinic and show what the eye can't see.

An accurate diagnosis means an accurate plan and fewer surprises.

In-house Dental Laboratory

Crowns and prosthetics are made in close collaboration with your dentist.

A better fit and quick communication between dentist and technician.

A Comfortable Setting

The clinic is designed to be as comfortable as possible for patients.

A calm visit — from the waiting area to the treatment room.

Arrival

Consultation
